hypotheses.title: Equity and duration diversification can fail together
hypotheses.rationale: A positive stock/bond correlation removes the portfolio's main diversification assumption.
hypotheses.expected_failure_mechanism: Simultaneous sleeve losses deepen portfolio drawdown.

hypotheses.title: A volatility regime jump can overwhelm fixed weights
hypotheses.rationale: Static weights do not reduce exposure when both sleeves become more volatile.
hypotheses.expected_failure_mechanism: Larger daily moves increase realized volatility and tail loss.

hypotheses.title: Execution costs can erode monthly rebalancing returns
hypotheses.rationale: Repeated turnover makes the net result sensitive to implementation friction.
hypotheses.expected_failure_mechanism: Higher costs reduce the terminal net return.
